name: Close-Grip Push-Up
summary: A bodyweight pressing exercise performed with hands positioned shoulder-width or narrower and elbows tucked tight to the torso to emphasize the triceps.

setup: Assume a high plank position on the floor with your feet together and your body forming a straight line from heels to head.
Place your hands directly beneath your shoulders or slightly inside shoulder width, with fingers pointing forward or slightly angled outward.
Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and screw your hands into the floor to set your shoulders.
steps: Inhale and lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows directly backward, keeping them tucked tightly against your ribs.
Descend under control until your chest gently touches or hovers just above the floor.
Exhale and press forcefully through your palms, extending your elbows to return to the starting position.
instructions.breathing: Inhale smoothly as you lower your body toward the floor, and exhale forcefully as you press up to lockout.

common_faults.fault: Flaring the elbows outward away from the torso.
common_faults.correction: Actively track your elbows straight backward along your ribcage throughout the entire repetition.

common_faults.fault: Sagging at the hips or hyper-extending the lower back.
common_faults.correction: Squeeze the glutes and pull the belly button toward the spine to maintain a rigid plank.

common_faults.fault: Cutting the range of motion short at the bottom.
common_faults.correction: Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor before reversing the movement.

precautions: If you experience wrist discomfort from the narrow angle, slightly angle the fingers outward or perform the movement on push-up handles or parallettes.
